entities.text: High Court Of Orissa At Cuttack
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Coram: Justice S. Pujahari
 Order
Order 19.07.2021
No.
05. 1.
This matter is taken up by video conferencing mode.

2. The Petitioners apprehending their arrest in Badachana P.S. Case No.10 of 2021 registered for alleged commission of offences punishable under Sections 272, 273, 420 read with Section 34 of the I.P.C. and Section 56 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, have filed this petition for their release on pre-arrest bail.

3. Heard the learned counsel for the Petitioner and the learned counsel for the State.
4. Considering the fact that the Petitioners are indulged in adulteration of food articles which endangers the health of the public in general, I am not inclined to enlarge the Petitioners on pre-arrest bail.
Accordingly, the prayer for pre-arrest bail of the Petitioners stands rejected and the ABLAPL is disposed of being dismissed.
6. The interim order dated 08.03.2021 passed by this Court shall stands vacated.
